verdict.rationale: Only community evidence covers this story, and it shows mixed results. One user reports being able to disable iCloud, Siri, location, suggestions and bug reporting, yet says the OS still 'phones home constantly' even with everything opted out. Others describe executable-hash checks (trustd/syspolicyd/OCSP) that have no evidenced opt-out and can only be blocked with a hosts-file hack. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of telemetry/analytics opt-out settings, a supported way to disable executable-verification network calls, and independent confirmation that opting out actually stops usage tracking.
